    The push-down as a module over the path algebra #

    For a quiver morphism p : D → Q and a representation X of D, the push-down p_*X (Construction 3.12) is the total space ⊕_i X(i) with e_q acting as the projection onto ⊕_{p(i)=q} X(i) and an arrow c acting by the sum of the arrow operators of the arrows labelled c. This file builds the algebra homomorphism kQ → End_k(⊕_i X(i)).
